finalText:
**Wrote the 4.2.0 entry** to [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md).

Out of 380 commits, one real feature and ten user-visible fixes, plus one breaking change:

- `401` replaces `403` for an expired token
- webhook deliveries now retry with backoff
- duplicate headers, null-cursor pagination crashes, double-trimmed trailing slashes, unhandled empty allowlists, dropped trace ids, wrong histogram units, socket-drop hangs, pool-not-closed-on-shutdown, full request body logged, unclear parser errors

Same fix (e.g. null-cursor guard, duplicate header) landed separately across several modules, so I merged those into single bullets. Worth a second look before you publish: the 401/403 change and the body-logging fix, since both could affect callers or count as security-relevant.
